characters.name: mallet-mole
characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original mascot character exploration sheet for 日语敲敲 / qiaoqiao, a cozy Chinese-facing Japanese typing practice website. An original adorable round baby mole companion for a Japanese typing learning app. Cocoa-brown bean-shaped body, warm cream muzzle and belly, two tiny dot eyes, rosy cheeks, little mitten paws, no visible claws, small green neckerchief, a rounded honey-colored wooden toy mallet. Distinctive endearing slightly determined expression. Three full-body poses of the SAME character: left sitting quietly hugging the mallet; middle happily tapping an ivory keyboard key with the mallet; right celebrating with both paws raised and two tiny golden sparkles. No violence, no armor. Style: beautifully polished contemporary Japanese stationery illustration, simple hand-drawn rounded deep brown outlines, matte flat pastel fills, tiny restrained soft shading, charming readable silhouette usable later at 64px. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT pixel art. Composition: a single wide horizontal white character sheet, three equally sized separated poses in one row, full bodies uncropped, generous breathing room, consistent proportions and colors. Each pose fills its third of the sheet. No text, no labels, no UI panels, no branding, no watermark, no scenery, no complex decorative clutter. Color palette warm cream, forest/sage green, light wood, restrained peach. These are concept previews, not a sprite atlas.
